title: androsace sarmentosa subsp. primuloides
intro: Androsace sarmentosa subsp. primuloides, commonly known as Himalayan rock jasmine, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various forms to harness its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Himalayan rock jasmine include wound healing, anti-ulcerogenic, and anti-diarrheal effects, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Furthermore, the plant has been studied for its potential in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress, suggesting its potential use in the management of various diseases.
